findings.claim: TrendForce：光纖供給缺口延續至至少2028；2026年產能利用率92%，庫存由2024年4個月降至1個月；新預製棒產能需18–24個月
findings.source: TrendForce press center, Optical Fiber Spot Prices Surge Severalfold in 2026
findings.excerpt: global optical fiber capacity utilization has climbed to 92% in 2026, while inventory levels have fallen from four months in 2024 to just one month

findings.claim: TrendForce：資料中心占光纖需求比重由2026年約18–20%升至2027年30–35%
findings.excerpt: Global optical fiber demand is estimated to reach 577 million fiber-kilometers in 2026, driven primarily by data center construction, which accounts for roughly 18–20% of the total. That share is projected to rise to 30–35% in 2027.

findings.claim: Verizon與Corning 2026年9月簽多年供貨協議，涵蓋1.29億光纖公里、2027–2032交付
findings.excerpt: In September 2026, Verizon and Corning signed a multi-year supply agreement covering 129 million fiber-kilometers

findings.claim: Corning稱已與客戶敲定類似Meta約60億美元的長期產能保留協議，財務影響2027起、2028逐步放大（隨新產能上線）
findings.source: Converge Digest, Corning Jan 2026 earnings coverage
